products.name: Homemade Dutch Chocolate Cake (Eggless)
products.description: Fresh homemade chocolate cake prepared with premium cocoa and pure butter. Melt-in-the-mouth texture, 100% vegetarian & eggless.

afterSales.instructions: Please take a photo and keep the cake chilled if requesting replacement.

products.additionalInfo: Keep refrigerated. Consume within 48 hours for best flavour.

products.name: Handcrafted Eco-Friendly Jute Tote Bag
products.description: Durable, stylish hand-stitched jute tote bag crafted by rural women artisans. Features brass rivets, cotton inner lining, and sturdy zipper.

afterSales.instructions: Upload a picture of any stitch flaw or zipper damage.

products.additionalInfo: Spot clean with damp cloth. Do not soak.

products.name: Home Style South Indian Meals Tiffin
products.description: Hot, hygienic home-cooked meal packed in eco-friendly foil containers: Steamed Rice, Sambar, Rasam, Palya (Poriyal), Curd, Papad & Pickle.

afterSales.instructions: Report any temperature or spill issue immediately upon receipt.

products.additionalInfo: Cooked fresh at 11:30 AM every morning in small batches.

products.name: Assorted Gourmet Cupcakes (Box of 4)
products.description: Four freshly baked soft sponge cupcakes with silky buttercream swirls: 2 Vanilla Velvet and 2 Dark Cocoa.

products.name: Authentic Avakkai Mango Pickle (500g Jar)
products.description: Traditional home-made raw mango pickle seasoned with cold-pressed sesame oil, freshly ground mustard, and Guntur chili powder.

afterSales.instructions: Report if safety seal or jar is damaged.

products.additionalInfo: Use dry spoon always. Stays aromatic and fresh naturally.

orders.orderNote: Please keep extra napkins if possible, thank you!

reviews.comment: Absolutely heavenly chocolate cake! Soft, moist, and not overly sweet. Delivered right on time in pristine packaging.
Ordered for our anniversary. The personalized cake message was written with so much care. Everyone in our family loved it!
Very sturdy jute bag. Love that it supports local women weavers. Would appreciate longer strap options next time!
